title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
title_zh: SwarmRSI：通过演化科学智能体群实现递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents’ research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can pursue this goal when one agent’s findings and implementations advance another’s research. Two obstacles stand in the way. A failed experiment does not reveal whether its hypothesis or its implementation was at fault, and a program without overall gains can hide components that other agents need. We introduce SwarmRSI , a framework in which a swarm improves its research by evolving the research states its agents inherit, including hypotheses, programs and experimental evidence. Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation uses other agents’ feedback to decide whether to revise a hypothesis or its program. Complementary Swarm Recombination tests retained hypotheses on other agents’ programs and combines complementary components. Recursive Swarm Evolution returns every outcome to a shared graph that guides which state each agent updates next. SwarmRSI achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on OpenProblems and NatureBench. With Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, it reaches an average score of 76.2 on OpenProblems, and it matches the published SOTA on 44.4% of NatureBench tasks, the highest Match-SOTA rate among compared methods. On MLE-Bench Lite, it wins medals on 81.8% of tasks, above hypothesis and program evolution agents with the same backbone. With DeepSeek-V4-Pro in one seed over all 90 NatureBench tasks, about 77% of final best programs descend from a rebase, a crossover or an update triggered by feedback. Biologists reproduce two of its programs and use them in follow-up analyses of intestinal and splenic immunity.

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents’ research capabilities through their own experimental experience ( Guo et al., 2026a ; Srikanth et al., 2026 ) . Scientific agent swarms offer a way to pursue this goal by coordinating idea generation, implementation, and evaluation across specialized agents ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . Persistent memories and shared histories retain experimental experience for later research ( Lyu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Weng et al., 2026 ) , and accumulated histories can also support improvements to exploration strategies ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Together, these capabilities create an opportunity for agents exploring different directions to use one another’s findings and implementations in subsequent research.
paragraphs.zh: 科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）旨在通过智能体自身的实验经验来提升其研究能力（Guo 等，2026a；Srikanth 等，2026）。 科学智能体群体提供了一种实现这一目标的方法，即通过协调专业智能体之间的创意生成、实施与评估（Yang 等，2025；Tang 等，2025；Yamada 等，2025；Lee 等，2026）。 持久记忆和共享历史能够保留实验经验以供后续研究使用（Lyu 等，2026；Zhu 等，2026；Du 等，2026；Weng 等，2026），而积累的历史数据也有助于改进探索策略（Zheng 等，2026）。 这些能力共同创造了机会，使探索不同方向的智能体能够在后续研究中利用彼此的研究成果和实施方法。

paragraphs.en: However, sharing experience does not ensure that agents use it to make better research decisions. Program evolution refines executable candidates through execution feedback ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while hypothesis evolution improves research directions through iterative generation and evaluation ( Gottweis et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . As Figure 1 illustrates, promising hypotheses are abandoned after inadequate implementations, and useful components are overlooked in programs that perform poorly overall.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，共享经验并不能确保智能体会据此做出更优的研究决策。 程序演化通过执行反馈来优化可执行的候选方案（Jiang et al., 2025；Nam et al., 2025；Novikov et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025），而假设演化则通过迭代生成与评估来改进研究方向（Gottweis et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2026；Jin et al., 2026）。 如图1所示，在实施效果不佳后，有前景的假设会被放弃；而在整体表现较差的程序中，有用的组件也往往被忽视。

paragraphs.en: We hypothesize that these limitations arise from two interrelated dependencies in scientific research. The value of a hypothesis depends on how it is implemented and how rigorously it is tested. An unsuccessful experiment therefore leaves unclear whether the research direction or its implementation needs revision ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Koo et al., 2026 ) , and feedback from other agents identifies which changes are worth pursuing. Intermediate results also become stepping stones for other search paths ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) , and their value depends on combinations with later findings or implementations. Their current performance thus underestimates their contribution to other agents’ future research. This leads to our central question of how scientific agent swarms can evolve toward recursive self-improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推测，这些局限性源于科学研究中两个相互关联的依赖关系。 一个假设的价值取决于其实施方式以及测试的严谨程度。 因此，一次失败的实验无法明确说明是研究方向需要调整，还是其实施过程需要改进（Ma et al., 2026; Koo et al., 2026），而其他智能体的反馈则能识别出哪些改变值得继续推进。 中间结果也能为其他搜索路径提供跳板（Wang et al., 2019; Wang et al., 2020），其价值取决于与后续发现或实施的结合。 因此，它们当前的表现低估了它们对其他智能体未来研究的贡献。 这引出了我们的核心问题：科学智能体群如何能够朝着递归式自我改进的方向演化。

paragraphs.en: To address this, we introduce SwarmRSI , a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. Each agent uses its hypotheses, programs, experimental evidence, and unresolved needs to plan further research, and a shared graph records these inheritable research states. In Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation, agents revise hypotheses and programs using other agents’ experimental feedback. Performance differences inform hypothesis revision, and unmet research needs guide implementation changes. In Complementary Swarm Recombination, agents revisit retained hypotheses on other agents’ implementations and combine program components with complementary strengths. Recursive Swarm Evolution evaluates the resulting candidates, retains useful results, feedback and unresolved needs in the shared graph, and uses these states to decide which hypotheses agents revisit and which programs they refine. Each experiment thus updates the states that later agents start from.

paragraphs.en: We formulate RSI for scientific agent swarms as evolving inheritable research states, so that each experiment updates the hypotheses, programs and evidence that later agents start from.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将科学智能体群中的 RSI 建模为可演化的可遗传研究状态，这样每次实验都会更新后续智能体所依据的假设、程序和证据。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SwarmRSI , which updates these states through Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation, Complementary Swarm Recombination and Recursive Swarm Evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SwarmRSI，它通过反馈引导的群体变异、互补群体重组和递归群体演化来更新这些状态。

paragraphs.en: SwarmRSI achieves SOTA results on OpenProblems and NatureBench, most of its final NatureBench programs build on inherited states, and biologists reproduce its programs for immune analyses.
paragraphs.zh: SwarmRSI 在 OpenProblems 和 NatureBench 上取得了 SOTA 结果，其最终的 NatureBench 程序大多基于继承状态构建，生物学家也对其程序进行了复现以进行免疫分析。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents automate scientific research through hypothesis generation, experiment implementation, and result evaluation ( Tang et al., 2025 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) . Agents centred on programs search over or refine code with execution feedback ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ) , R&D-Agent coordinates proposal generation and implementation through specialized roles ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and systems with memory carry execution experience into later experiments ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our setting, Arbor links explicit hypotheses to programs and experimental evidence in a persistent hypothesis tree ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , and SAGE evaluates competing failure explanations to direct interventions toward hypotheses, experimental design, or implementation ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . SwarmRSI likewise grounds hypotheses in experiments and lets agents use one another’s feedback and partial results.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体通过生成假设、执行实验和评估结果来自动化科学研究（Tang 等人，2025；Yamada 等人，2025）。 以程序为中心的智能体通过执行反馈搜索或优化代码（Jiang 等人，2025；Nam 等人，2025）；R&D-Agent 通过专门的角色协调提案的生成与实施（Yang 等人，2025）；而具备记忆的系统则会将执行经验带入后续实验（Zhu 等人，2026；Du 等人，2026）。 最接近我们设定的是 Arbor，它将明确的假设与程序和实验证据连接到一个持久的假设树中（Jin 等人，2026）；而 SAGE 则通过评估相互竞争的失败解释，将干预方向指向假设、实验设计或实施（Ma 等人，2026）。 SwarmRSI 同样将假设建立在实验基础上，并允许智能体使用彼此提供的反馈和局部结果。

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement uses an agent’s own experience to improve the mechanisms that guide its subsequent activity. AIDE 2 retains accepted code modifications as the basis for further self-improvement ( Srikanth et al., 2026 ) , Dream-RSI refines exploration policies with replay simulators built from historical discovery trees ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , MASS alternates workflow evolution with model fine-tuning ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and AQuA uses recorded experiments to guide later research proposals ( Guo et al., 2026a ) . These methods improve the agent’s code, policy, workflow, or proposals. SwarmRSI instead evolves the research states that agents inherit, revising them with other agents’ feedback and reusing retained hypotheses and program components across agents.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进利用智能体自身的经验来优化指导其后续活动的机制。 AIDE 2 将已接受的代码修改保留下来，作为进一步自我改进的基础（Srikanth 等，2026）；Dream-RSI 使用基于历史发现树构建的重播模拟器来优化探索策略（Zheng 等，2026）；MASS 在流程演化和模型微调之间交替进行（Lee 等，2026）；而 AQuA 则利用记录下来的实验来指导后续的研究提案（Guo 等，2026a）。 这些方法能够改进智能体的代码、策略、工作流程或研究提案。 SwarmRSI 则通过修订智能体所继承的研究状态来实现进化，这一过程会结合其他智能体的反馈，并在不同智能体之间重复利用保留下来的假设和程序组件。

paragraphs.en: We address four research questions and illustrate biological applications through case studies: RQ1 : How does SwarmRSI perform across benchmarks and backbones, and at what token cost? RQ2 : How do Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation, Complementary Swarm Recombination, and Recursive Swarm Evolution contribute to performance? RQ3 : How do experimental feedback and reused intermediate results guide the swarm’s subsequent research within and across tasks? RQ4 : What are the main failure modes, and how frequent are they?
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对四个研究问题展开探讨，并通过案例研究展示其生物学应用：研究问题1（RQ1）：SwarmRSI 在不同基准测试和基础模型中的表现如何？其令牌成本又是多少？ 研究问题2（RQ2）：反馈引导的群体变异、互补群体重组和递归群体演化分别对性能提升有何贡献？ 研究问题3（RQ3）：实验反馈与可重用的中间结果如何指导群体在任务内部及跨任务中的后续探索？ 研究问题4（RQ4）：其主要失效模式有哪些？这些失效出现的频率如何？

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SwarmRSI on scientific coding and machine-learning engineering tasks across three benchmarks. OpenProblems ( Luecken et al., 2025 ) contains six single-cell analysis tasks following TusoAI ( Turcan et al., 2026 ) . NatureBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) contains all 90 scientific coding tasks across six domains. MLE-Bench Lite ( Chan et al., 2025 ) contains 22 competitions from its low-complexity split.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个基准测试中，通过科学编码和机器学习工程任务来评估 SwarmRSI。 OpenProblems（Luecken 等，2025）包含六个单细胞分析任务，遵循 TusoAI（Turcan 等，2026）。 NatureBench（Wang 等，2026b）包含六个领域中的所有 90 个科学编码任务。 MLE-Bench Lite（Chan 等，2025）包含其低复杂度分集中的 22 项竞赛。

paragraphs.en: We compare against program evolution agents (AIDE and MLEvolve), hypothesis evolution agents (Arbor), domain-specific scientific agents (TusoAI and Biomni ( Huang et al., 2026 ) ), and general coding agents (Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , Codex ( OpenAI, 2026a ) and Gemini CLI ( Google, 2026 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将与程序演化智能体（AIDE 和 MLEvolve）、假设演化智能体（Arbor）、领域特定的科学智能体（TusoAI 和 Biomni（Huang 等人，2026）），以及通用编码智能体（Claude Code（Anthropic，2026）、Codex（OpenAI，2026a）和 Gemini CLI（Google，2026））进行比较。

paragraphs.en: OpenProblems reports normalized task scores scaled by 100 and their unweighted mean. NatureBench reports Match-SOTA ( g ≥ 0 g\geq 0 ) and Surpass-SOTA ( g > 0.1 g>0.1 ) rates, where g g is the official direction-adjusted improvement over SOTA. MLE-Bench Lite reports Above Median and medal rates from official grading on the private test split. Rates retain all tasks in the denominator, including invalid or missing results. Match-SOTA comparisons with Arbor and AIDE on NatureBench use 95% paired bootstrap confidence intervals and McNemar tests, and other comparisons are descriptive. Token cost sums uncached input and output tokens over all LLM calls in a search.
paragraphs.zh: OpenProblems 报告了归一化任务分数（乘以 100 缩放）及其未经加权平均的数值。 NatureBench 报告了 Match-SOTA（g ≥ 0，其中 g 是相对于 SOTA 的经官方方向调整后的改进值）和 Surpass-SOTA（g > 0.1）比率。 MLE-Bench Lite 报告了基于私有测试集官方评分的“高于中位数”比率及奖牌率。 这些比率在分母中保留了所有任务，包括无效或缺失结果的任务。 NatureBench 上与 Arbor 和 AIDE 的 Match-SOTA 比较使用了 95% 配对自助置信区间和 McNemar 检验，而其他比较仅为描述性分析。 令牌成本计算了单次搜索中所有 LLM 调用所消耗的未缓存输入和输出令牌总数。

paragraphs.en: SwarmRSI outperforms domain-specific and general coding agents. With DeepSeek-V4-Pro, it reaches an OpenProblems average of 74.2 against 67.1 for TusoAI and exceeds Claude Code with the same backbone by 21.1 percentage points (pp) in NatureBench Match-SOTA.
paragraphs.zh: SwarmRSI 的表现优于领域专用和通用编码智能体。 借助 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，它在 OpenProblems 上的平均得分为 74.2，而 TusoAI 为 67.1；在 NatureBench Match-SOTA 中，其得分比采用相同基础架构的 Claude Code 高出 21.1 个百分点（pp）。

sents.en: SwarmRSI outperforms domain-specific and general coding agents.
sents.zh: SwarmRSI 的表现优于领域专用和通用编码智能体。

paragraphs.en: SwarmRSI revises with prior feedback. In one NatureBench seed with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, updates triggered by performance feedback or unresolved implementation requests reach a 28.4% rate of new bests, against 21.9% over all updates. paragraphs.en: SwarmRSI reuses partial results across research trajectories. In the same seed, about 77% of final best programs descend from at least one rebase, crossover or update triggered by feedback, and these updates yield new bests more often than other updates at every stage of search. On 00639, crossover combines components from three programs to reach Match-SOTA, and a later rebase step activates retained message-passing and ranking-loss code that the program had not executed, further improving g g . On 00795, rebase tests an unrealized hypothesis on a later program, and crossover then reuses a component from a program that had not improved overall.

paragraphs.en: We annotate 644 failed attempts from 35 SwarmRSI task trajectories that fall below Match-SOTA on NatureBench or earn no medal on MLE-Bench Lite. Two annotators judge implementation fidelity, execution success and improvement over the preceding best valid result, with Cohen’s κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 . Most failures are faithful interventions without gains. They account for 93.3% of these failures, and implementation or execution problems for 6.7%. A valid score can hide such a problem, as on task 00838, where downstream code overwrites a proposed amino-acid substitution that the evaluation thus never tests, which is why Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation reads implementation evidence alongside scores. On task 02316, by contrast, a negative-binomial mixture with a Potts spatial prior runs correctly but collapses all locations into one cluster, a faithful intervention without gain.
paragraphs.zh: 我们标注了来自 35 条 SwarmRSI 任务轨迹中的 644 次失败尝试，这些尝试在 NatureBench 上的表现低于 Match-SOTA，或在 MLE-Bench Lite 上未获得任何奖牌。 两名标注员对实现保真度、执行成功性以及相较于先前最佳有效结果的改进程度进行判断，Cohen’s κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 。 大多数失败都是忠实干预但未能带来任何提升。 这些失败占此类失败的 93.3%，而实现或执行问题则占 6.7%。 有效分数可能掩盖此类问题，例如在任务 00838 中，下游代码覆盖了所提议的氨基酸替换，导致评估从未对该替换进行测试；正因如此，Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation 才会同时读取实现证据和分数。 相比之下，在任务 02316 中，一个带有 Potts 空间先验的负二项混合模型虽然运行正确，但却将所有位置合并为一个簇，这属于一种忠实干预但未能带来任何提升的情况。

paragraphs.en: Enterocyte: infection-associated immune expression. On the contrastiveVI task ( Weinberger et al., 2023 ) , the evolved program removes from each infected cell the mean of its healthy neighbours before reducing the residuals. On the Haber intestinal instance ( Haber et al., 2017 ) , measured enterocyte RNA shows higher MHC-II scores in helminth day 10 than Salmonella infection, with means of 1.17 and 0.34. Figure 5 a–c shows the corresponding expression gradients on the reproduced representation. Within the two helminth day-10 sources, MHC-II scores are locally more coherent on this representation than on RNA PCA, with Spearman’s ρ \rho after covariate adjustment of 0.77 and 0.69 against 0.65 and 0.40, whereas antimicrobial scores are less locally coherent than on RNA PCA in each of the four sources.

paragraphs.en: CytoCommunity: spatial context without consistent marker shifts. On the CytoCommunity task ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , the evolved program combines anatomical priors derived from phenotypes with an anatomically constrained Markov random field, raising g g from 0.045 to 0.102. Figure 5 d–f compares its partitions with manual anatomy and experts’ subsequent grouping of B-cell neighbourhoods by local cell composition. Across three spleen images, 20–21% of B cells in the manually annotated marginal zone occupy myeloid/erythroid-rich neighbourhoods. Goltsev et al. paragraphs.en: We began with two obstacles for scientific agent swarms. A failed experiment does not show whether its hypothesis or its implementation was at fault, and a program without overall gains can still hold a component that another agent needs. SwarmRSI addresses both. Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation uses other agents’ feedback to decide whether to revise a hypothesis or repair its program, and Complementary Swarm Recombination carries retained hypotheses and useful components into other agents’ work. Recursive Swarm Evolution returns every outcome to the shared graph, so each experiment changes the states that later agents start from. It achieves SOTA results on OpenProblems and NatureBench and outperforms baselines with the same backbone, most final NatureBench programs build on such reuse, and biologists reproduce its programs for follow-up analyses of intestinal and splenic immunity. A swarm thus improves its own research by evolving what its agents inherit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最初面临科学智能体群体中的两个障碍。 一次失败的实验无法说明是其假设还是实现方式出了问题，而一个没有整体收益的程序仍可能包含其他智能体所需的组件。SwarmRSI 同时解决了这两个问题。 反馈引导的群体突变利用其他智能体的反馈来决定是修订假设还是修复其程序，而互补群体重组则将保留的假设和有用组件整合到其他智能体的工作中。 递归群体演化将每个结果都返回到共享图中，因此每次实验都会改变后续智能体开始时的状态。 它在 OpenProblems 和 NatureBench 上取得了 SOTA 结果，并优于使用相同基础架构的基线模型；大多数最终的 NatureBench 程序都建立在这种重用之上，生物学家也复现了其程序以进行肠道和脾脏免疫的后续分析。 因此，一个群体通过演化其智能体所继承的内容来改进自身的研究。

The code audit uses execution status, artifact validity and evaluator feedback to check execution and the task contract. The scientific audit screens implementation evidence by comparing parent and offspring source code and recorded submitted outputs. paragraphs.en: We compare NatureBench Match-SOTA outcomes for SwarmRSI , Arbor and AIDE with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, using the 90 tasks as paired units. paragraphs.en: Feedback-linked updates and component reuse. We analyze one complete seed (90 runs) with DeepSeek-V4-Pro and recorded request identifiers. These runs cover all 90 NatureBench tasks and comprise 1,948 search attempts and 426 new-best candidates. Program feedback prompted hypothesis mutations, while unresolved implementation requests for retained hypotheses prompted rebase updates on the program frontier. We matched these updates to their originating requests using recorded request and episode identifiers. These updates comprised 296 attempts (15.2%) and produced 84 new-best candidates (19.7%), a 28.4% new-best rate versus the overall 21.9%. Including crossover, the union of these events comprised 731 attempts (37.5%) and produced 173 new-best candidates (40.6%).
paragraphs.zh: 与反馈相关的更新和组件重用。 我们使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 分析了一个完整的种子（90 次运行），并记录了请求标识符。 这些运行覆盖了全部 90 个 NatureBench 任务，共包含 1,948 次搜索尝试和 426 个新的最佳候选方案。 程序反馈触发了假设的变异，而未解决的保留假设的实现请求则触发了程序前沿的重基更新。 我们利用记录下来的请求和回合标识符，将这些更新与它们最初产生的请求进行了匹配。 这些更新包括 296 次尝试（15.2%），并产生了 84 个新的最佳候选方案（19.7%），新最佳方案的产生率为 28.4%，高于总体 21.9% 的比率。 包括交叉操作在内，这些事件的合集共包含 731 次尝试（37.5%），并产生了 173 个新的最佳候选方案（40.6%）。

paragraphs.en: Cumulative progress across search stages. To examine whether progress builds on inherited research states, we trace each run’s final best program through its recorded code-parent and intervention-source edges. In about 77% of runs, this lineage contains at least one rebase, crossover, or update triggered by feedback. Table 11 further divides each run’s attempts into early, middle and late thirds by step order. Reuse and update triggered by feedbacks achieve higher new-best rates than other updates in every stage, and their share of new-best candidates increases slightly over the course of search. The overall new-best rate declines as search proceeds, consistent with diminishing returns as the incumbent improves.
paragraphs.zh: 各搜索阶段中的累积进展。 为了检验进展是否建立在继承的研究状态之上，我们追踪每次运行中最终的最佳程序，通过其记录在案的代码父节点和干预源边进行追溯。 在大约 77% 的运行中，这一谱系至少包含一次由反馈触发的重新基准、交叉或更新。 表 11 进一步按照步骤顺序，将每次运行的尝试划分为早期、中期和晚期三个阶段。 在所有阶段中，由反馈触发的重用和更新都比其他更新实现了更高的新最佳率，且它们在新最佳候选者中的占比在整个搜索过程中略有上升。 随着搜索的推进，整体新最佳率逐渐下降，这与当前最优解不断改善所带来的收益递减现象一致。

paragraphs.en: After each generation, the accumulated research state is preserved for subsequent tasks. This state includes hypotheses, program components, experimental evidence, and unresolved implementation needs. On a new task, prior records are retrieved by matching their mechanism labels to the task description and initialize the agent’s research state, while candidate programs are adapted and evaluated under the new task’s constraints.

paragraphs.en: We run SwarmRSI with DeepSeek-V4-Pro on six NatureBench source tasks in three generations of two tasks each, and each generation starts from the cross-task state exported by the previous one. We then search 12 held-out NatureBench tasks, fixed in advance and disjoint from the source tasks, from an empty state and from the state after each generation, with three seeds and the same budget per task. As shown in Table 12 , mean g g rises from 12.01 under cold start to 16.15, 20.16 and 21.89 after one, two and three generations, and Gen 3 improves on cold start by 9.88 points. Match-SOTA rises from 41.7% to 86.1% and Surpass-SOTA from 33.3% to 58.3%, while tokens per task fall from 12.17M to 10.94M. Gains are largest over the first two generations, and Gen 3 matches Gen 2 on Match-SOTA and improves mainly through Surpass-SOTA. Unlike the main experiments described in Section B.7 , some held-out tasks cross the Match-SOTA or Surpass-SOTA threshold in only some seeds, so the rates in Table 12 count the 36 task and seed pairs, for example 31 of 36 for Match-SOTA after Gen 3.

paragraphs.en: Annotators examined the proposed intervention, implementation and execution records, evaluator outputs, and preceding scores. Implementation or execution failure denotes an intervention that could not be reliably tested because of code or interface errors, execution interruptions, or proposal–implementation mismatches. No performance gain denotes a faithfully implemented and executed intervention with a valid evaluation that did not improve the preceding best valid result. Equal scores were treated as no gain. Recovered intermediate errors were judged by the final evaluated outcome. Successful verification or restoration of an existing result, and repetition of an attained metric ceiling, were excluded from the failure counts. Attempts with insufficient evidence to distinguish the two failure classes were also excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 标注员审查了拟议的干预措施、实施与执行记录、评估员输出以及先前得分。 实施或执行失败指因代码或接口错误、执行中断，或提案与实施不匹配而无法可靠测试的干预措施。 无性能提升指已忠实实施和执行的干预措施，在有效评估中未能优于先前最佳有效结果。 得分相同被视为无提升。 已恢复的中间错误根据最终评估结果进行判断。 对现有结果的成功验证或恢复，以及对已达指标上限的重复，均不计入失败次数。 缺乏足够证据以区分两种失败类型的尝试也被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: For Haber, the program normalizes total counts to 10,000 and applies log1p, selects 2,000 genes by variance across target and background cells, and standardizes using background means and standard deviations, clipping at ± 10 \pm 10 . It identifies 20 healthy neighbours per target in a 50-dimensional background PCA space and subtracts their mean expression. A singular-value decomposition yields a 20-dimensional residual space. A 15-neighbour graph then smooths the first ten residual coordinates for two iterations, including a self weight. Experts reproduced the program. Local-coherence analysis uses its ten-dimensional outputs. The embedding is constructed from RNA, and infection labels parsed from public cell identifiers are used for diagnostic silhouette reporting.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Haber 而言，该程序将总计数归一化为 10,000 并应用 log1p，根据目标细胞和背景细胞间的方差选择 2,000 个基因，然后使用背景均值和标准差进行标准化，并将数值裁剪至 ±10 \pm 10。 它在 50 维的背景 PCA 空间中为每个目标识别出 20 个健康邻域，并减去它们的平均表达值。 通过奇异值分解可得到一个 20 维的残差空间。 随后，一个包含 15 个邻域的图对前十个残差坐标进行两轮平滑处理，其中也包括自权重。 专家们成功复现了该程序。 局部相干性分析使用其十维输出结果。 嵌入由 RNA 构建，而通过公共细胞标识符解析出的感染标签则用于诊断轮廓报告。

paragraphs.en: Each program score is the arithmetic mean of its genes’ log ⁡ ( 1 + 10 4 ​ x / ∑ x ) \log(1+10^{4}x/\sum x) expression. The MHC-II-associated set is Cd74, H2-Aa, H2-Ab1 and H2-Eb1 (the input matrix uses dots in the H2 gene names). The interferon set is Stat1, Isg15, Ifit1, Ifit3, Oas1a and Irf7. All six genes are present in the matrix. The antimicrobial set contains Reg3g, Reg3b, Lcn2 and Saa1. Its signal is dominated by Reg3g/Reg3b, with Lcn2 undetected and Saa1 low in these enterocytes. B1–B4 are control sources, B5/B6 helminth day 3, B7/B8 helminth day 10, and B9/B10 Salmonella. Source labels denote sequencing batches. paragraphs.en: NatureBench task s41592-023-02124-2 uses three healthy mouse spleen CODEX images associated with CytoCommunity ( Hu et al., 2024 ) : 82,382, 81,925 and 80,973 cells, respectively, with 27 supplied cell phenotypes. The program selected by SwarmRSI comes from step 12 of a 15-step search and raises g g from 0.04507 to 0.10215. It uses phenotype-derived anatomical priors, 50-neighbour composition and interface features, Gaussian EM, an anatomically constrained spatial MRF and cleanup of components smaller than 150 cells. Recorded macro-F1 and AMI are 0.639247 and 0.583341. Macro-F1 includes the unannotated reference category, whose F1 is zero. Marginal-zone F1 is 0.600, 0.593 and 0.635.

paragraphs.en: The analysis includes 35,168, 33,544 and 32,451 conventionally annotated B cells (101,163 total). Measurements are transformed as arcsinh ⁡ ( x / 150 ) \operatorname{arcsinh}(x/150) , retaining negative values. Effects are differences of transformed means divided by the within-image contrast-population standard deviation. Intervals use 1,000 bootstrap resamples of 1,000-coordinate-unit spatial blocks within each image. B220 effects are + 0.082 +0.082 , − 0.130 -0.130 and − 0.190 -0.190 . paragraphs.en: SwarmRSI requires an evaluator that can execute candidate programs, so research without executable feedback is outside its scope. Execution feedback does not always reveal whether the intended intervention was faithfully implemented, and performance gains alone do not establish its scientific mechanism. Rebase selects program bases by matching recorded implementation needs to program mechanism labels, a heuristic that does not measure what a program can do. Crossover applies only when a benchmark reports scores per instance. H/P selection adapts discounted UCB without inheriting its guarantees, and its benefit is established only empirically.
paragraphs.zh: SwarmRSI 需要一个能够执行候选程序的评估器，因此没有可执行反馈的研究不在其研究范围内。 执行反馈并不总能揭示预期的干预措施是否被忠实实施，而仅凭性能提升也无法确立其科学机制。 Rebase 通过匹配已记录的实现需求与程序机制标签来选择程序基础，这是一种启发式方法，并未衡量程序的实际能力。 仅在基准测试报告每个实例的分数时，才会应用交叉操作。 H/P 选择方法对折扣 UCB 进行了调整，但未继承其理论保证，其优势仅通过实证得到验证。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation covers comparisons under matched budgets on three benchmark families. The human failure analysis characterizes 644 annotated failed attempts from 35 task trajectories. Cross-task evidence comes from six source tasks, 12 held-out tasks and one backbone, and generations are confounded with the number of source tasks seen.
paragraphs.zh: 评估涵盖在三个基准数据集上，于匹配预算条件下的比较。 人类失败分析对来自 35 个任务轨迹的 644 个已标注的失败尝试进行了特征描述。 跨任务证据来自六个源任务、12 个预留任务和一个主干模型，而生成的结果与所见的源任务数量存在混淆。

sents.en: Evaluation covers comparisons under matched budgets on three benchmark families.
sents.zh: 评估涵盖在三个基准数据集上，于匹配预算条件下的比较。

sents.en: The human failure analysis characterizes 644 annotated failed attempts from 35 task trajectories.
sents.zh: 人类失败分析对来自 35 个任务轨迹的 644 个已标注的失败尝试进行了特征描述。

sents.en: Cross-task evidence comes from six source tasks, 12 held-out tasks and one backbone, and generations are confounded with the number of source tasks seen.
sents.zh: 跨任务证据来自六个源任务、12 个预留任务和一个主干模型，而生成的结果与所见的源任务数量存在混淆。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation does not separately assess literature synthesis ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , idea quality ( Sauter et al., 2026 ) , or peer-review quality ( Guo et al., 2026b ) . Generalization to complete research workflows ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Schmidgall et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) and information-access agents ( Kanoulas et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) requires additional evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估并未单独考察文献综合（Shi 等，2025）、观点质量（Sauter 等，2026）或同行评审质量（Guo 等，2026b）。 向完整研究工作流程（Lu 等，2024；Schmidgall 等，2025；Lyu 等，2026）和信息获取智能体（Kanoulas 等，2025；Cao 等，2026）的泛化能力需要进一步的评估。

paragraphs.en: Other untested settings include legal reasoning ( Lyu et al., 2022 ; Lyu et al., 2023a ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , zero-shot entity extraction ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , conversational recommendation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and shopping research ( Lyu et al., 2025c ) . These settings require task-specific objectives and evaluation protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 其他未经测试的设置包括法律推理（Lyu 等人，2022；Lyu 等人，2023a；Wu 等人，2023）、零样本实体提取（Wang 等人，2025）、对话式推荐（Zhang 等人，2024）以及购物研究（Lyu 等人，2025c）。 这些设置需要任务特定的目标和评估协议。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark gains do not establish factual reliability or alignment with human preferences, which require separate evaluation and optimization ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Lyu et al., 2024a ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Lyu et al., 2025b ) . We do not assess robustness to dataset shortcuts ( Lyu et al., 2023b ) , social stereotypes ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , or cognitive biases ( Lyu et al., 2024b ; Lyu et al., 2025a ) , nor do we test harmful-content generation. Applications that affect people should preserve user agency and provide domain-appropriate human oversight ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试中的提升并不能证明模型具备事实可靠性或与人类偏好的对齐，这些方面需要单独进行评估和优化（Lin 等，2022；Lyu 等，2024a；Rafailov 等，2023；Lyu 等，2025b）。 我们未评估模型对数据集捷径（Lyu 等，2023b）、社会刻板印象（Parrish 等，2022）或认知偏见（Lyu 等，2024b；Lyu 等，2025a）的鲁棒性，也未测试其生成有害内容的能力。 影响人类的应用程序应保留用户的自主权，并提供符合特定领域需求的人类监督机制（Zhang 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Generated programs and scientific interpretations require independent validation before use beyond the benchmark setting. The execution and scientific audits check task validity and implementation evidence; they do not certify security or scientific correctness. The biological case studies analyse existing datasets, and their associations do not establish causal mechanisms or clinical validity. Any deployment should restrict code execution, external-tool access and credentials to the approved scope, and review proposed uses for potential harm.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的程序和科学解释在超出基准设置的环境中使用前，需要独立验证。 执行过程和科学审计会检查任务的合理性与实施证据；但它们并不认证安全性或科学正确性。 这些生物学案例研究分析了现有数据集，但其中的关联关系并未确立因果机制或临床有效性。 任何部署都应将代码执行、外部工具访问和凭证限制在批准的范围内，并审查拟议用途可能带来的潜在危害。

paragraphs.en: Data reuse should respect source licences, access restrictions and privacy requirements, with provenance and intended uses documented ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) . We report time budgets, hardware configurations and token consumption to support resource-aware comparisons ( Schwartz et al., 2020 ) . Token consumption is not a direct measurement of energy use or carbon emissions.
paragraphs.zh: 数据重用应尊重源数据的许可协议、访问限制和隐私要求，并记录其来源和预期用途（Gebru 等人，2021）。 我们报告了时间预算、硬件配置和令牌消耗情况，以支持基于资源意识的比较（Schwartz 等人，2020）。 令牌消耗并非能源使用或碳排放的直接衡量指标。
